# statusdrift_api_keys (Data Source)

Fetches all API keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statusdrift_api_keys" "all" {}

output "all_api_key_names" {
  value = [for k in data.statusdrift_api_keys.all.api_keys : k.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `api_keys` (Attributes List) List of API keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_keys))
- `id` (String) Placeholder ID for Terraform state.

<a id="nestedatt--api_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_keys`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The date/time the API key was created.
- `expires_at` (String) The expiration date/time in ISO 8601 format, or null if non-expiring.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the API key.
- `is_expired` (Boolean) Whether the API key has expired.
- `key_prefix` (String) The first 12 characters of the API key.
- `name` (String) The name of the API key.
